name: capture.take
description: Claims a reel or a post someone shared with the capture account, under the id made from Meta's message id. A claim made before (Meta sends again, or the DM read found it too) claims nothing. Answers the brand this sender saved to last. Internal: packages/connect's webhook, as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: with c as (insert into brandbase.captures (id, account, sender, created_at) values (:id, :account, :sender, :now::timestamptz) on conflict (id) do nothing returning 1) select jsonb_build_object('claimed', exists (select 1 from c), 'lastBrand', (select s.last_brand from brandbase.capture_senders s where s.account = :account and s.sender = :sender)) as result
